findings.summary: A Windows-style path string is emitted verbatim as a file name when the helper runs on the Linux host.
findings.detail: Create(Guid, string?) delegates splitting to Path.GetFileName, whose separator semantics are host-platform. On the pinned Linux verification host a backslash is a valid file-name character, so a string such as "C:\\dir\\file.mkv" would be emitted whole rather than split. ADR-026 clause 1 explicitly names Path.GetFileName and Jellyfin reports host-native paths; on the pinned Linux host a real media path is POSIX, so no directory component can be emitted from a genuine input. The worker recorded this as an interpretation; it does not change persisted or user-visible state and is not a task defect.
findings.recommended_action: No action for 15.1; the behavior follows ADR-026's explicit Path.GetFileName choice.
